mapper.sql: rm.id, rm.read_yn, rm.create_yn, rm.update_yn, rm.delete_yn, rm.created_at, m.id AS m_id, m.name AS m_name, m.path AS m_path, m.icon AS m_icon, m.sort_order AS m_sort_order, m.used_yn AS m_used_yn, m.created_at AS m_created_at, m.updated_at AS m_updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_role_menu rm JOIN app_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT FROM app_role_menu rm JOIN app_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN app_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id WHERE r.used_yn = 'Y' AND rm.role_id IN (SELECT ur.role_id FROM app_user_role ur JOIN app_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_role_menu (role_id, menu_id, read_yn, create_yn, update_yn, delete_yn, created_at) VALUES (#{role.id}, #{menu.id}, #{canRead}, #{canCreate}, #{canUpdate}, #{canDelete}, #{createdAt})
